# ExploreIndonesia.ai

> AI-powered Indonesia trip planner. We publish hand-picked, day-by-day Indonesia
> itineraries (Bali, Java, Komodo, Flores, Lombok, the Gili Islands, Sumatra,
> Raja Ampat and beyond) and turn travel plans into bookable trips — stays,
> transfers, tours and experiences.

- [All trips](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips): Browse every Indonesia itinerary, filterable by destination, length, style, traveller and vibe.
- [7 Days in Bali for First-Timers](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/7-days-bali-first-timers): Ubud, Canggu, Nusa Penida and Uluwatu.
- [5 Days in Bali](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/5-days-bali-ubud-canggu-uluwatu): Ubud, Canggu and Uluwatu short escape.

- [7 Days in Yogyakarta and East Java](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/7-days-yogyakarta-east-java): Borobudur, Bromo and Ijen.
- [5 Days in Labuan Bajo and Komodo National Park](https://exploreindonesia.ai/trips/5-days-labuan-bajo-komodo)

## Destinations
Facts below are working estimates from our own transport and destination pages
(linked); confirm current schedules and prices before booking, since operators
and seasons change them.

- [Bali](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/bali): Ubud rice terraces, Canggu surf, Uluwatu cliffs, East Bali volcanoes. The hub most other Indonesia trips are built around.
- [Bali + Nearby Islands](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/bali-nearby-islands): Nusa Penida/Lembongan/Ceningan are 25-45 min by fast boat from Sanur; the Gilis are 1.5-2.5h at sea from Padangbai/Serangan plus a road transfer; Lombok is a 30-45 min flight from Denpasar; Komodo (Labuan Bajo) ~1h15 flight; Java (Yogyakarta) ~1h25 flight.
- [Java](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/java): 5 days covers Yogyakarta + one volcano (Borobudur, Prambanan, Bromo or Ijen); 7-8 days does the full east-bound Bromo+Ijen crossing into Bali. Jakarta-Yogyakarta by executive train is ~6-7.5h. Best season for clear crater sunrises: April-October (dry).
- [Komodo & Flores](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/komodo-flores): Komodo dragons, Padar Island viewpoint, Pink Beach, Kelimutu's three-coloured crater lakes. Covered via liveaboards and day boats from Labuan Bajo, plus overland Flores routes.
- [Lombok & Gili Islands](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/lombok-gili): Gili Air is the balanced choice (quiet + enough restaurants), Gili Trawangan the only one with nightlife, Gili Meno the quietest. Bali-to-Gilis fast boat is 1.5-2.5h at sea; Bali-to-Lombok is a 30-45 min flight or 2-3.5h by boat; Lombok-to-Gilis public boat is 15-30 min (~$2-4). Best season (calmer crossings): May-October.
- [Sumatra](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/sumatra): four separate regions, each with its own flight gateway — North Sumatra via Medan (Bukit Lawang orangutans, Lake Toba), West Sumatra via Padang (Harau Valley, Minangkabau culture), Aceh via Banda Aceh (warm-water diving off Pulau Weh), Kerinci via Padang + long road transfer (volcano trek). Domestic flights beat overland transfers between regions.
- [Raja Ampat](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/raja-ampat): Coral Triangle diving and liveaboards — Wayag viewpoints, Manta Sandy, Misool, homestays on Kri and Arborek.
- [Wild Indonesia (off-the-beaten-path)](https://exploreindonesia.ai/destinations/wild-indonesia): Sulawesi routes from 8 to 14 days — Toraja culture, Bunaken and Wakatobi diving, the Togean Islands.

## MCP connector (for AI agents)
- Endpoint: https://exploreindonesia.ai/api/mcp (JSON-RPC 2.0 / MCP Streamable HTTP, no auth required)
- Tools: `search_itineraries` (query our published itineraries by destination, travel style, traveller type, trip length), `match_trip` (resolve a drafted day-by-day plan into real bookable affiliate products with deep links), `get_booking_links` (single-item version of the same).
- Use this instead of scraping when you need current, structured itinerary or booking data rather than page text.

## About
- Each itinerary is structured day by day with a route, best time to go, where to stay, practical info and FAQs.
- Content is editorial and regularly updated; affiliate links fund the site and are marked accordingly.
- Sitemap: https://exploreindonesia.ai/sitemap.xml
